<Story title="DigiStepper">
    <DigiStepper v-model="step" :steps="steps" />
    <DigiButton
      variant="secondary"
      class="mt-4 mr-2"
      @click="step = Math.max(0, step - 1)"
    >
      Previous
    </DigiButton>
    <DigiButton
      class="mt-4"
      variant="success"
      @click="step = Math.min(steps.length - 1, step + 1)"
    >
      Next
    </DigiButton>
  </Story>
